summary: Implemented transactional single and batched lane progress appends, lane-local automatic sequencing, validation, ordered cursor reads, isolated cutoff pruning, and best-effort error reporting hooks. Added focused real-SQLite coverage for atomicity, ordering, retention, reporting, and concurrent status writes, then recorded the implementation in commit 71fa45b.

files_changed.why: Provide the lane_progress write, query, validation, retention, and reporting APIs.
Prove progress API ordering, sequence allocation, atomicity, pruning isolation, reporting, and concurrency behavior.
Required packet result envelope; generated after the implementation commit.

external_changes.why: Project instructions require rebuilding the installed binary after code changes; `lucind-ai -v` now reports build 71fa45b.
external_changes.revert: Rebuild and install lucind-ai from the prior repository commit 8dd2630.

done_criteria.criterion: `internal/ledger/progress.go` and its test file are the only authored paths.
done_criteria.evidence: `git show --stat --oneline 71fa45b` reports exactly internal/ledger/progress.go and internal/ledger/progress_test.go, 399 insertions; `.lucind/result.json` is the required generated envelope.

done_criteria.criterion: `go test ./internal/ledger -run Progress` passes and the commit is recorded.
done_criteria.evidence: `go test ./internal/ledger -run Progress` exited 0 with `ok github.com/LanzerDevCorp/lucind-ai/internal/ledger`; commit 71fa45b is HEAD with message `feat(ledger): add progress batch APIs`.

findings.finding: The focused race run and full ledger package regression also pass.
findings.evidence: `go test ./internal/ledger -run Progress -count=1 -race` and `go test ./internal/ledger -count=1` both exited 0.
findings.affects: Provides additional confidence in concurrent sequence allocation and package compatibility.
